pages.title: Fall Cushion
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r II$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Boots$(br2)§lEffect: §r Reduces damage from high falls and knocks back nearby enemies with a shockwave on hard landings. Conflicts with Elegant Catwalk.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
